lanzamiento.texto: Out today on consoles, at midnight local time in each country. In Peru it unlocked at 00:00. No PC version or online mode for now.

novedades.texto: New: the official map of Leonida, with zoom to see every area.
Now with official images of the characters and regions of Leonida.
Missions expanded with Eurogamer: 96 missions with their objective and who you play them with, plus the «Strangers and Freaks» side missions and new tips.
New: the 91 story missions by chapter, so you can check off the ones you finish.
Cheats reviewed with GAMES.GG: all 17 codes match, and there are new tips to plan which cheats to unlock.
Cheat names reviewed, requirements fixed and two secrets added: playing in first person and Paul Walker's car.
New: all 61 cheats with their buttons (16 confirmed), over 50 weapons by category and the illustrated map of Leonida.
First version of the guide: regions, characters, editions, what's new and tips to get started.
GTA VI is now on sale for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Metacritic gives it a 99.
Digital pre-load opened on PlayStation and Xbox.

regiones.resumen: The state's big city: beaches, art deco, neon and a lot of money at stake.
regiones.texto:
Rockstar presents it as the sun and fun capital, where glamour, hustle and greed come together. It is the heart of Leonida and the densest area of the map.

According to Kotaku, the story starts far from here: you reach Vice City after about twelve hours of play. Outlets count more than 600 shops and interiors, and GameSpot notes that barbers, tattoo parlors and stores don't repeat.
lugares: Ocean Beach: pastel art deco hotels and white sand.
Little Cuba: a neighborhood known for its bakeries.
Tisha-Wocka flea market: the place for knockoff brands.
Port of Vice City (VC Port): the «cruise capital of the world».
Stockyard: streetwear and tattoos; home to Stock 305 and Electric Fang Tattoo.
Southside: turf of the PTT Youngin$ gang.
Washington Beach: where the Ultimate Edition's Squalo speedboat is docked.
Club Delights Cabaret, Ocean View Hotel and Fleeca bank branches.

regiones.resumen: Tropical islands linked by bridges. Jason's story starts here.
regiones.texto:
An island chain with a quiet, no-frills life and bars where nobody dresses up to get in. It has some of the most beautiful waters in the country, and some of the most dangerous too.

It is the home turf of Brian Heder and his boatyard, and where Jason lives at the start. Official material shows iguanas, seaplanes, diving among turtles and coral, and boat parties.

Tip from GameSpot: do the Keys side missions before you leave, because coming back later is a long trip.

regiones.resumen: Wild swamps and mangroves, famous for their alligators.
regiones.texto:
Rockstar calls it Leonida's untamed jewel: miles of mangroves where alligators are the best-known attraction, though not the most dangerous.

Official screenshots show airboats, hunters and police chases through the swamp. Be careful when swimming: there are alligators in the water.

regiones.resumen: The forgotten coast: cheap motels, closed attractions and empty malls.
regiones.texto:
A run-down port whose economy, according to Rockstar, runs on cheap beer, painkillers and gas station energy drinks. They suggest getting around on a dirt bike and watching your wallet.

Screenshots show a motel, a roadside strip club and bonfires. Fans compare it to the Florida Panhandle, but Rockstar has not confirmed it.

regiones.resumen: Leonida's industrial heartland, with a sugar refinery and bikers.
regiones.texto:
Industry and old-fashioned values rule here. The Allied Crystal sugar refinery provides almost all the jobs, and the local biker gang takes care of almost everything else. That gang's name has not been confirmed yet.

Screenshots show smokestacks and burning crop fields. Fans compare it to the sugar region around Lake Okeechobee, with no official confirmation.
lugares: Lake Leonida: home to the One-Eyed Willie's off-road shop (Ultimate Edition).

regiones.resumen: A national park in the north: hunting, fishing and off-road trails.
regiones.texto:
A national park on the state's northern border, great for hunting, fishing and riding dirt bikes or ATVs. The surrounding woods are home to people who prefer to stay far from the government.

Official material shows cougars, deer, kayaks and mountain roads. Kotaku mentions a peak with night views of the city.

personajes.resumen: Ex-soldier who works for drug runners in the Keys.
personajes.texto:
He grew up around grifters and crooks. He joined the Army to leave a rough adolescence behind and ended up in the Keys doing what he does best: jobs for local drug runners. He wants an easy life, but things keep getting harder.

He lives in a property owned by Brian Heder in exchange for helping him with collections and shakedowns. Reviews describe him as reserved, loyal and the voice of reason in the couple.
personajes.spoiler: His own missions revolve around the record label of Dre'Quan, whom GameSpot describes as Jason's lifelong friend, and around the Real Dimez.

personajes.resumen: Out of Leonida Penitentiary and after the good life.
personajes.texto:
Her father taught her to fight as soon as she could walk. Fighting for her family landed her in Leonida Penitentiary, and she got out by sheer luck. Now she only wants to make smart moves.

She is after the good life her mother dreamed of since their days in Liberty City, and she sees a way out in Jason. The press presents her as the series' first female lead of the modern era.
personajes.spoiler: Her mother is called Mia, and her friend Andy has her own mission line (according to GameSpot).

personajes.resumen: Paranoid homebody who believes everything he reads online.
personajes.texto: Jason's friend and another of Brian's associates. Happy at home, he spends his time listening in on Coast Guard radio with a few beers and is convinced everything on the internet is true.

A classic dealer from the golden age of smuggling in the Keys. He still moves product from his boatyard with Lori, his third wife, and leaves the dirty work to others. He lends Jason a house in exchange for favors.

personajes.resumen: Went from the streets to a legit empire of clubs and music.
personajes.texto: A local legend who turned his street past into a legit empire: real estate, a strip club and a recording studio. What he cares about most is his label Only Raw Records, which he runs with Dre'Quan.

personajes.resumen: More hustler than gangster, he wants to be a music mogul.
personajes.texto: Boobie's partner at Only Raw Records. He just signed the Real Dimez and wants to stop booking shows at Boobie's club and take over the Vice City scene.

personajes.resumen: Bae-Luxe and Roxy, friends since school.
personajes.texto: Friends since high school, they made money robbing dealers before turning to rap and social media. They had a hit with rapper DWNPLY and, years and many problems later, they sign with Only Raw Records.

personajes.resumen: A heist veteran, confident and reckless.
personajes.texto: An experienced, cunning robber looking for people willing to take risks. His recklessness raises the stakes on every job.

personajes.resumen: Hires you to recover abandoned classic cars.
personajes.texto: A local middleman and eccentric collector. His classic car jobs are part of the Ultimate Edition content.

personajes.resumen: Appears in the credits; his exact role is not confirmed.
personajes.texto: He is played by Brad Carter, according to the credits. Some fan sites say he is the pilot on Brian's smuggling flights, but it is not verified.

guias.intro: Spoiler-free tips published on launch day. Check off the ones you've already used.

items.texto: There are 15 manual save slots. The game autosaves after each mission, but you can't save in the middle of one.
If you die or get arrested, you lose the cash you carry. Find an ATM with the bank app and put your money away.
Exploring shipwrecks is one of the easiest ways to make money early on.
There is a sales limit, but it resets when you sleep.

items.titulo: Avoid banks and loan sharks early on
items.texto: Most of the cash comes with dye packs that explode if you get too far away.

items.titulo: Keep spare clothes in the trunk
items.texto: Changing clothes helps you lose the police.

items.titulo: At one star, calm the officer down
items.texto: If you don't have a weapon in hand, aim at the officer with the left trigger to try to calm things down.
Cars with the red tracker icon alert the police. Scan them first with the Waink app.
In Focus mode, alarmed doors glow red. Use the lockpick or find another way in.
Call a RydeMe and, once in the car, pay $100 to skip to your destination.
If Jason is far away, switch to Lucia: she is usually waiting near the safehouse. It's free transport.
Besides refueling, they repair your car, and it's usually cheaper than Scooter Bros.

items.titulo: Eat and drink before heading out
items.texto: It boosts health, stamina and Focus.
It's cheap at Ammu-Nation from the start.

items.titulo: Finish the Keys before you leave
items.texto: Coming back later for side missions is a long trip.
Hold Down on the D-pad to see what's nearby. If a mission doesn't show up, look for it in the map's mission list.
If the controls feel slow, lower it in the settings.
You won't have a bank account until the middle of Chapter 1, and if you get arrested you lose what you carry. Search the house well: there is a hiding spot for money.

items.titulo: See what the police know about you
items.texto: Icons tell you how they identify you: your clothes, your vehicle, whether you're alone or with your partner. Change exactly that to lose them.
If Jason and Lucia don't do activities together, their romance can break. They'll keep working together, but you'll miss an important part of the game.
Some have GPS and tell the police where you are in real time.
One specialist guide says the money and car upgrades from that chapter are lost when it ends. Major outlets haven't confirmed it yet.

guias.intro: What each edition includes and how much it costs. Prices may vary by store and exchange rate.

items.texto: The base game, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The physical version is a box with a download code, no disc.
The game plus the Ultimate upgrade. Digital only. If you already own the Standard Edition, the upgrade is sold separately for about US$20.

The '95 Grotti Cheetah sports car, the Hawk & Little Morgan revolvers and custom versions of Jason's and Lucia's pistols. Also Vice City-style clothes, hairstyles and tattoos, vehicles for Jason's safehouse, the Shitzu Squalo speedboat, a '67 Vapid Dominator buggy and the Paradise Garage.

It also unlocks five exclusive locations: Rideout Customs, Sara's Unisex Salon, Stock 305, Electric Fang Tattoo and One-Eyed Willie's. Everything unlocks as you progress through the story chapters.

The Vintage Vice City Pack includes the '55 Vapid Stanier sedan, a garage near Ocean Beach, vintage clothes for Jason and Lucia and a tropical weapon design. Digital purchases add one free month of GTA+.

Each store gives a slightly different deadline (November 19 or 20).
The Peruvian PS Store charges in dollars: US$79.99 and US$99.99, about S/ 279–299 depending on your card's exchange rate. It's not confirmed whether IGV (sales tax) is added.

guias.intro: Where you can play and what you need.

items.texto: PS5, PS5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S. On Xbox One you can only play through the cloud (Xbox Cloud Gaming), with Series S graphics quality and buying the game separately.
At midnight local time in each country. On PS5 it depends on your PSN account's country: changing the console clock won't make it unlock sooner.
No PC version has been announced. The dates going around are rumors.
No. GTA VI launches as single-player only. GTA V's GTA Online is still supported. A GTA VI multiplayer in 2027 is just a rumor.
Up to 212 GB free. Leave about 250 GB for patches: on a 512 GB Series S it takes up more than half the drive.

30 fps on all consoles, including PS5 Pro, with no performance mode. Rockstar says it was designed this way to keep the world's density and detail.

PS5 Pro adds PSSR upscaling and ray-traced shadows. According to Digital Foundry, cited by several outlets, the Series S is the weakest version.

guias.intro: Rockstar didn't publish an official list: this comes from its «An Extended Look» video and from reviews.

items.texto: You play as Jason and Lucia and switch between them in a couple of seconds. They can go together or apart; when you're not controlling them, they follow their routine and text you.

There are now up to 6 wanted stars, and not every crime gives you stars: someone has to see you or report you. The police remember your clothes, your weapon and your car, and the crime area stays «hot».

To shake them off, change clothes or cars, destroy the cameras or split up from your partner. The police no longer appear on the minimap.
Each character has one, similar to honor in Red Dead Redemption 2: it shows whether you act like a professional or use unnecessary violence.
You can rob stores even if they aren't marked, as well as banks and armored trucks, alone or as a couple. The loot has a carrying limit and is sold to specialized fences.
Snapmatic is the social network. BuckMe is the bank. RydeMe works as a taxi and fast travel. Scooter Bros brings or repairs your car, and Waink scans cars to check their security and value.
You carry two small weapons and two long ones; the rest stay in the vehicle. Auto-aim is off by default. Focus mode slows down time and marks weak spots to disarm or wound without killing.
The physics mix GTA IV's weight with GTA V's accessibility. There is fuel, and gas stations also do repairs. To keep a stolen car, register it at a Pay 'n' Spray.
Health, stamina and Focus improve by training, eating and sleeping. If you stop training, you lose progress.
Underwater there is a lung meter. You can dive for treasure and shoot while swimming.
Includes birds, mammals, fish and reptiles, with rare and legendary species like in Red Dead Redemption 2.
Basketball, pool, mini golf, golf, tennis, fishing, hunting, skydiving, kayaking, diving, races and dates. There are hurricanes and tropical storms.

guias.intro: The names come from official material and from guides that copy the Ammu-Nation menu. The ones in the first list were shown by Rockstar.

items.texto: Two concealed small weapons and two long ones: one on your back and one in hand. The rest are stored in your personal vehicle's trunk or in Ammu-Nation lockers, where you can also get back the ones you bought.

Most are bought at Ammu-Nation. Sniper rifles, machine guns, and grenade and rocket launchers are only in the big stores. You can also take them from enemies.

The Ultimate Edition includes engraved revolvers for Jason and Lucia, their custom pistols and a crate of explosives on the Shitzu Squalo speedboat.

guias.intro: First, what Rockstar showed. What the launch revealed stays hidden.

items.texto: Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. An easy score goes wrong and drags them into a criminal conspiracy that spans all of Leonida. To get out alive, they'll have to rely on each other more than ever.
In the «An Extended Look» video, the couple takes jobs from different clients: robberies, escorts and deliveries.

The campaign has five chapters and 91 main missions, and it revolves around big heists set up over several missions. The main story takes 65 to 80 hours depending on the outlet; with side activities, about 90 to 100; and 100% completion takes over 200.
Jason fixes up a waterfront house that Brian lends him before Lucia gets out of prison, and she joins a few hours in. You reach Vice City after about twelve hours.
There is a relationship system between Jason and Lucia, and Kotaku says there are multiple endings based on your choices. Rockstar has not confirmed it.
Each new chapter opens up areas, contacts and activities. It's worth taking a drive around Leonida before moving on with the story.

It starts with Jason while Lucia is still in prison: small smuggling runs and errands at a relaxed pace to get to know Leonida. It ends with Lucia's release. There are 22 missions, and you can't switch characters freely yet.
Lucia takes the lead in Port Gellhorn, wearing an ankle monitor, finding her place among new friends and petty crime. At the end she reunites with Jason. There are 11 missions.
The couple arrives in the big city and gets into the underworld: drugs, car thefts and bank robberies, all the way to a big cartel heist. It's the longest chapter, with 26 missions.

Jason and Lucia set up their own business in Ocean Beach. The pace picks up with security jobs, deliveries and undercover missions, and it ends with one of the story's big showdowns. There are 25 missions.

guias.intro: What critics said on launch day.

items.texto:
Metacritic: 99 on PS5, tied with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, the site's highest-rated game. OpenCritic: 99.

IGN and GameSpot gave it 10/10; Eurogamer and GamesRadar+, 5/5; Game Informer, 100.
The most alive and detailed open world of the generation, the lead couple, the graphics, the sound and the police chases.
The locked 30 fps, parts of the story that drag on, somewhat clunky aiming and how hard it is to make money.

guias.intro: Cheat names as most guides list them in English. «Confirmed»: at least two outlets give the same code. We'll keep adding the missing ones.

items.titulo: Open the phone and get the code ready
items.texto: Press Up to take out the phone, hold L1 (LB on Xbox) and press R1 (RB). Then enter the cheat's D-pad sequence. It's the same on PS5 and Xbox.

They only work after you finish the story, and each one has its own challenge in Pause › Progress › Cheats. They disable saving and trophies: make a separate save and reload it to get them back. GTA V codes don't work.

items.titulo: Start with the ones that need nothing else
items.texto: $250,000, Unlimited Focus, Attack Force and Cycle Weather unlock just by finishing the story. They're the first ones you can try.
With 25 bronze medals you unlock Max Ammo; with 25 silver, Infinite Ammo; and with 25 gold, No Reload. If gold is giving you trouble, the other two will do in the meantime.

items.titulo: Play as a couple for the filters
items.texto: Several filters unlock by spending time with your partner, holding hands or robbing stores together. Keep Jason and Lucia together in your normal playthrough and you'll unlock them with no extra effort.

items.titulo: Each challenge category gives two vehicles
items.texto: Completing 5 challenges in a category unlocks a vehicle, and completing all of them unlocks a better one. For example, in survival: 5 challenges give the airboat; all of them give the Rhino tank.

items.titulo: Use cheats in a separate save
items.texto: Since they disable saving and trophies, save to another slot first. Work on your trophies in a normal playthrough and save the cheats for when you want to goof around.

It's a camera glitch found by the community, not an official cheat.

1. In the controller settings, set the camera switch to the touchpad (PS5) or the View button (Xbox).
2. Get into a vehicle and take out the phone with Up.
3. Put the phone away with Circle (or B) and press the camera button several times right after.

If the view stays locked, get out: you'll stay in first person, though with animation glitches. To go back to normal, load a save. Rockstar could remove it in a patch.

items.titulo: Paul Walker's car from «The Fast and the Furious»
items.texto: From the start of the game you can grab a replica of the 1995 sports car Paul Walker drove, with its color and decals. According to Vandal, it's in a garage east of the Isla Catalana area: force the door, take it and register it at a Pay 'n' Spray for $6,750 (you must have unlocked vehicle registration first).
